query: Crea una PowerPoint Accenture da questi documenti di stima
expected_behavior: Reads every source file first, then writes a self contained Python script to /tmp/gen_presentation_<projectname>.py and executes it
Confirms the output path and the file size, and notes per slide which source document it was derived from
Final answer follows the 'Presentation generated / Size / Slides produced / Source files read / Notes' block

query: Costruisci un pitch deck per lo steering committee
expected_behavior: Uses the executive audience mode: cover, agenda, problem, solution, timeline, no implementation detail dump

Only Accenture brand colours and fonts appear in the generated .pptx, and the timeline or effort slide carries the numbers from fixtures/estimation.md (333 giorni uomo, 30 settimane, the five workstream windows) with no figure absent from the fixture
No source file is modified, deleted or overwritten

Loads `accenture-branding` with the Skill tool (tool_used: Skill) before writing the generation script, and the effect is visible: the script's colour constants are the RGBColor values that skill defines rather than arbitrary hex codes

query: Aggiorna il deck di architettura con la nuova proposta
expected_behavior: Architecture slides are drawn as labelled shapes: no imported image file and no empty box
Nothing is invented: any section the sources do not cover is marked 'To be defined, source data not available' rather than filled with a plausible guess
No TODO or placeholder is left in the generated .pptx
